sentences.text: Researchers created a ZIF-8 nanocarrier designed to deliver the drug tectorigenin more effectively, testing it in a lab model of starving muscle cells and a mouse model where the sciatic nerve was crushed to induce atrophy.

In the cell model, the nanocarrier treatment restored muscle tube width to 92% of normal levels, whereas in mice, nerve injury caused leg muscle mass to drop by 35% and fiber size to shrink by 41% before the nanocarrier increased mass to 74% of normal and fiber size to 93%, with treated mice also showing better movement abilities.

The authors suggest the treatment works by calming specific breakdown systems in muscle cells, boosting protein building signals, and lowering oxidative stress and inflammation, concluding that this nanotechnology approach offers a promising strategy for treating muscle wasting caused by nerve damage.
